主要内容: On March 2, 2017, KENTUCKY BANCSHARES, INC. announced a quarterly cash dividend of 29 cents per share, an increase from the previous quarter's 27 cents per share. The dividend will be paid to shareholders of record as of March 15, 2017, on March 31, 2017. This update is part of the company's regular dividend distribution process and reflects its ongoing financial performance and shareholder return strategy. The information is disclosed in the Form 8-K filing with the SEC, which includes a press release announcing the dividend for the first quarter of 2017. No additional financial details or market impacts are provided in the text.
